feeds.title: Every Breath I Take
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Lisa Goldman. I was diagnosed with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), Adenocarcinoma (ROS1+) at age 41. This is a blog about my journey with lung cancer where I will be covering the latest updates, lung cancer facts, and more.

feeds.title: Lung Cancer Research Foundation News
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest happenings and news at the Lung Cancer Research Foundation. The mission of the Lung Cancer Research Foundation (LCRF) is to improve lung cancer outcomes by funding research for the prevention, diagnosis, treatment and cure of lung cancer.

feeds.title: Gray Connections
feeds.description: Janet Freeman-Daily is a writer, speaker, and science geek, and cancer survivor. This blog is a place she uses to capture perspectives and new developments in lung cancer and the brain. She also shares notes about her writing, health, travels, and anything else she finds particularly intriguing.

feeds.title: Emily Bennett Taylor
feeds.description: Emily used to kick butt on the volleyball court, now she's kicking cancer! Follow us and stay up to date on news and updates about Emily.

feeds.title: Dann's Cancer Chronicles
feeds.description: A lung cancer survivor's story of hope and inspiration told through emails to family and friends.

feeds.title: A Lil Lytnin' Strikes Lung Cancer
feeds.description: A blog about life as a mom of a singleton, living with stage IV lung cancer, theater artist and traveler through life. Follow us and keep up with her regular updates.

feeds.title: Keeping my Faith - Living with Stage IV Lung Cancer
feeds.description: This blog is about Samantha Mixon who is living with Stage 4 Lung Cancer.

feeds.title: Faith Family & Friends
feeds.description: A blog by Lysa Buonanno - a mom, wife, daughter, advocate, and stage IV lung cancer survivor. I'm here to help others and to inspire. Keep up with her regular articles.

feeds.title: The Research Evangelist
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Dave Bjork. I am a research evangelist, lung cancer survivor, and patient advocate in Boston, Massachusetts. I'm passionate about biomedical research and a champion for the biotech community. My blog is about shining a light on the people and events I encounter who inspire me because they do amazing things to advance medical research. I hope I can make some connections that will change the way research gets funded so we can bring more new ideas to life.

feeds.title: My 20+ Years Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about me, my feelings as I go through my life now with a chronic lung disease. I will try to give you an accurate portrayal of what I have gone through for than more than 20 years with lung cancer. I hope that it will help see you through your journey a bit easier.

feeds.title: The Insightful Breath
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Peggy Dennis. I am a wife, mother, lung cancer survivor, and advocate committed to living life fearlessly. Keep up with my regular updates through The Insightful Breath blog.

feeds.title: Cancer An Unexpected Journey
feeds.description: This is a blog about Luna's fears, cheers, and thoughts about living with lung cancer.

feeds.title: GO2 for Lung Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Information on lung cancer support groups, treatment centers, and awareness. GO2 Foundation is dedicated to saving, extending, and improving the lives of those vulnerable, at-risk, and diagnosed with lung cancer.

feeds.title: Roy Castle Blog
feeds.description: Latest news about new lung cancer treatment and research breakthroughs, as well as stories from those living with lung cancer. Roy Castle Lung Cancer Foundation is the only UK lung cancer charity dedicated to helping everyone affected by the disease. It is our mission to ensure everyone diagnosed with lung cancer can live well with the disease for as long as possible.

feeds.title: ALK Positive Blog
feeds.description: ALK Positive is a patient-driven organization, dedicated to improving the lives of ALK-positive lung cancer patients through support programs & funding groundbreaking research. We understand what you are going through, and hope to share what we've learned in our journey so far.

feeds.title: Outliving Lung Cancer
feeds.description: Hi! I am Linnea Olson. Patient, advocate, artist, blogger, mother of three, and surviving advanced lung cancer. I make art, write, advocate and activate for other cancer patients, and going on adventures. Keep up with my updates.
